                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'POST\n'[39m +

                      [32m'the file content inside the request body (perhaps with the correct Content-Type request header).\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The only difference on the protocol level is that\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'multipart/form-data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'requests must adhere to RFC 2388 while a custom typed request body can be arbitrary.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The practical implication from this is that a\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'multipart/form-data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'request is typically larger: While clients are technically allowed to use a non-7bit\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'content-transfer-encoding\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m', base64 is used by most.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'The MIME headers generate additional overhead that can become a bottleneck if many small files are uploaded.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'Note that support for\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'multipart/form-data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- If in doubt, go with\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'multipart/form-data\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'...\n'[39m +
                      [32m'- Notable that it depends where the file is coming from.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If the file is always coming from a frontend UI, multipart form-data makes sense.\n'[39m +
                      [32m'If the file is coming from a backend server, it is unlikely to be packaged as multi-part form data.'[39m
